answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive overview of **iCloud** and its key controls and features:

---

## ☁️ What is iCloud?

iCloud is a personal cloud service run by Apple. Launched on October 12, 2011, iCloud enables users to store and sync data across devices, including Apple Mail, Apple Calendar, Apple Photos, Apple Notes, contacts, settings, backups, and files, as well as collaborate with other users and track assets through Find My.

iCloud's client app is built into iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, tvOS, macOS, and visionOS, and is also available for Microsoft Windows. iCloud may additionally be accessed through a limited web interface.

---

## 📦 Storage & Plans

iCloud offers users **5 GB of free storage**, which may be upgraded through optional paid plans to up to 12 TB; all paid plans include iCloud+ providing additional features.

Apple offers four iCloud+ storage tiers: **50GB ($0.99/month)**, **200GB ($2.99/month)**, **2TB ($9.99/month)**, and higher capacity options up to 12TB.

---

## 🔒 Privacy & Security Controls

### Advanced Data Protection
Apple's **Advanced Data Protection** for iCloud uses end-to-end encryption to provide the highest level of cloud data security that Apple offers.

Optional end-to-end encryption has been available since 2022 for all iCloud data, except Calendar, Contacts, and Mail, which rely on legacy sync technologies for compatibility with third-party apps.

### iCloud Private Relay
**Private Relay**, a cornerstone of iCloud+, encrypts internet traffic to protect user privacy, functioning like a simplified VPN. When browsing in Safari, it routes data through two separate servers — one operated by Apple, which strips your IP address, and another by a third party, which assigns a temporary IP.

### Hide My Email
**Hide My Email** lets you generate unique, random email addresses that automatically forward to your personal inbox — and even let you reply — so you don't have to share your real email address when filling out a form on the web or signing up for a newsletter.

### Custom Email Domains
**Custom Email Domains** allow iCloud+ subscribers to use personal or business domain names with iCloud Mail. Users can set this up through iCloud settings, linking a domain they own and configuring up to five addresses for family or team members.

---

## 🗂️ File & Data Management

### iCloud Drive
**iCloud Drive** makes the files and folders you save easy to get to and share, no matter which device you're using. Access them all from the Files app on iOS and iPadOS, the Finder on your Mac, File Explorer for Windows PCs, or iCloud.com.

### iCloud Backup
**iCloud Backups** are encrypted automatically and stored in the cloud, and you can create and use them anywhere with a Wi-Fi connection.

### iCloud Keychain
**iCloud Keychain** is a password manager developed by Apple that syncs passwords across devices and suggests secure ones when creating new accounts.

---

## 👨‍👩‍👧 Family Sharing

You can share any iCloud+ plan with **up to five other people** in your Family Sharing group. Everyone will get access to the storage they need, along with features that keep them in control of their privacy, at no additional cost per user. A single subscription can cover everyone in your household, and each person's files, documents, and other personal information remain private and separate.

---

## 📸 Photos & Sharing

**Shared Photo Library** is the best way to seamlessly share photos and videos with up to five other people. Shared library content appears in Featured Photos and Memories so you can relive your adventures using photos everyone took.

---

## 📅 Apple Invites

One of the notable additions is **Apple Invites**, a new way to bring people together for everyday moments. Built on iCloud, Invites lets users create custom invitations for events large or small — from birthdays to casual gatherings — and guests can RSVP from any device, even without an Apple Account.

---

## 📍 Find My

**Find My** enables users to track the location of iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS devices, AirPods, AirTags, and supported third-party accessories through a connected iCloud account. A user can see the device's approximate location on a map, display a message and/or play a sound on the device (even if it is set to silent), and remotely erase its contents.

---

## 🤖 Smart Storage (Latest Updates)

In a recent update, Apple has unveiled a new feature for iCloud that doesn't just store data — it offers "smarter" tools for automatically organizing files and photos, making cloud space management a smoother and more secure experience.

---
